name: Divisor-Parity Conflict & Recursive Horner Objective
description: Replaced the explicit inequality/determinant conflict condition with a mathematically equivalent but conceptually distant number-theoretic property (product has an odd number of divisors iff it is a perfect square, which for values {1,2,3} means the values are equal). Replaced the explicit lexicographical sum formula with a recursive Horner's method evaluation, removing the hint about its closed form. This forces the model to deduce both the coloring constraint and the lexicographical early-exit property from scratch; failure to deduce the latter will result in an exhaustive search that times out.
